approved_payload.content: Four men were killed and eight people wounded when gunmen opened fire inside MaDlamini's Place tavern on Hlobe Street in the Greenpoint informal settlement, Khayelitsha, at about 11.30pm on Saturday 21 November, IOL and Cape Town ETC report from police. Police first said five were wounded; Western Cape Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Sizakhele Dyantyi later said the number rose to eight. Police say the gunmen fled in a vehicle hijacked at the scene, later found abandoned. Murder and attempted murder cases are being investigated; no motive or arrests were reported. The map point is approximate: the Khayelitsha point, not the tavern.
